# Version 4.154.0
> **Documentation and m154** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships compiler XML documentation with the NuGet packages. API documentation now travels beside the managed assemblies, while HarfBuzzSharp binding generation follows the native source pinned by Skia.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed** — The corrected upstream member is now named UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132, retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to CCC133 before upgrading. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available** — HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes aggregate *_DEFINED mask constants. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags your application needs combined explicitly. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream m154 bug fixes and a buffer upload correction. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Compiler XML documentation ships with packages** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation beside managed assemblies, making API documentation available directly to IDE consumers. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from Skia's pinned native source, keeping existing supported APIs synchronized with HarfBuzz 14.2.1.
